claims.claim: Increase productivity with a colour MFP
claims.evidence: Witness only reported a boxed HP desktop computer (system unit) in photo 0; no printer/MFP is shown.

claims.claim: Get the fastest in-class two-sided printing speed
claims.evidence: No printer/MFP or printing-speed information is visible in the witness report; only an HP desktop box is described.
The statement is incomplete and not tied to any readable model/specs in the witness report.

risks.risk: Item may not be the same as the seller is describing (seller talks about a colour MFP/printer, but the witness saw a boxed HP desktop PC).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the actual product label/model showing it is a printer/MFP (or a clear photo showing it is a desktop PC system unit) plus the full front/back view.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a boxed HP desktop PC with unknown specs and unknown working status (worst-case: untested/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Exact desktop model/specs (CPU/RAM/storage) are not readable from the photo, so performance/value is unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the box side label or the desktop system label showing model number and key specs (CPU/RAM/storage).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely spec tier for an HP desktop in similar packaging (worst-case: entry-level/older parts).

risks.risk: Unclear whether it is complete (monitor/keyboard/mouse) or only the system unit.
risks.proof: Photos showing everything included laid out (monitor, keyboard, mouse, power cable, etc.) or a checklist of included items.
risks.if_unproven: Price as system unit only (worst-case: no monitor/keyboard/mouse).

risks.risk: Condition and completeness beyond outer packaging are unknown (dents, missing parts, damaged ports).
risks.proof: Photos of the unboxed unit (front/back/ports) and close-ups of any damage; also a photo of all included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified condition (worst-case: may need repairs/parts).

risks.risk: No evidence it has been tested/working; could be dead-on-arrival or have faults.
risks.proof: A short video of power-on POST/BIOS screen and (if possible) boot into OS or BIOS with visible system info.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until proven.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the box label/model number and any visible spec stickers (CPU/RAM/storage).
Confirm whether the sale is the desktop system unit only or includes monitor/keyboard/mouse; send photos of all items included.
Send photos of the unboxed unit showing front/back ports and any visible damage.
Send a short power-on video showing POST/BIOS (or boot) to confirm it works.
If it is actually a printer/MFP (as the seller claims), send photos of the printer/MFP model label and the two-sided printing feature/specs.
response.reason: The witness report shows a boxed HP desktop PC, while the seller’s words describe a colour MFP/printer; this mismatch means the item cannot be confidently priced without proof of what is actually being sold and its exact model/specs.
